body: In the New York Times podcast, Chris Rock immediately shut down an interviewer who tried asking him about the Will Smith Oscars slap — making it clear he’s fully moved on. “I’m good, that was so long ago. I wish everyone well, I’ve moved on with my life… I’m not gonna get into clickbait things. I don’t think I’m in beef. ” A calm but firm reminder he’s not reopening old drama What’s your take on this moment chrisrock.
